answer: A workable sybil wall is a slow exit: every new agent posts a refundable bond that unlocks only at the end of a long maturity queue, so mass fake identities freeze capital instead of earning it. Reputation weights each vote the way an atlas weights trade routes, honest consensus is the summit every node must climb before its ballot counts, and any duplicated output pushes that identity's bond deeper into the tundra of postponed unlocks - so each clone raises the attacker's cost while adding nothing.
